NAME
  dcgm-exporter config explain
  Explain where each setting came from and what will be collected

USAGE
  dcgm-exporter config explain [OPTIONS] [PATH] [-o text|json] [--verbose] [--
  GLOBAL OPTIONS]

GENERAL OPTIONS
  --help, -h
    Show command help
    Default: false

RESULT OPTIONS
  --output, -o FORMAT
    Result FORMAT: text or json
    Default: "text"

  --verbose
    Show every setting and every collected field
    Default: false

  Exporter options after -- are applied as at startup; --config-file, --help and
  --version are not allowed there. Without PATH the file is chosen as at
  startup: --config-file, then DCGM_EXPORTER_CONFIG_FILE, then no file. --output
  and --verbose go before --, on either side of PATH; give --output only once.
  Use ./-name.yaml for a dash-leading filename.
  Inspection does not prove GPU, DCGM, API or socket availability; validate and
  explain list what was not checked. Exit status: 0 success, 1 any other
  failure, including an invalid configuration, 2 wrong command usage.

EXAMPLE
  dcgm-exporter config explain ./exporter.yaml -- --collect-interval 1000
